v0.6+ is ESM-only. GifOS inlines classic scripts, so this port pins the last
UMD. Two paste boxes, the HTML visual formatter, last pair saved privately.
Press Invite to show a read-only view of the same pair. Upstream is a library
with a demo page; this directory is the wrap. Nothing is fetched.
